name: Collar
source:
You, a broke college student named Salem, wake up in a cellar with a weird collar around your neck.

[From [url=https://zleepyzheep.itch.io/collar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你叫塞勒姆，是個窮光蛋大學生。一覺醒來，你發現自己躺在地窖裡，脖子上套著一隻古怪的項圈。

［摘自[url=https://zleepyzheep.itch.io/collar]itch.io[/url]］
